scope: Complete main-namespace wikitext articles with table and syntax repairs enabled. Protected examples, discussion content, section edits, redirects, disambiguation pages and syntax-ambiguous source decline.

tableShape.attributes: Exactly one class and one style attribute. No nested table or literal HTML table structure inside.
tableShape.style: Exactly three distinct literal declarations: width:100%, table-layout:fixed, and a positive min-width in px, em or rem. No other style, computed value, comment or duplicate declaration.

rules.before: A standalone div whose sole attribute is style and whose sole declaration is overflow-x:auto, immediately containing one complete table and no other text.
rules.after: The same div gains max-width:100% and min-width:0. Its horizontal scrolling remains automatic.
rules.purpose: Constrain the existing scroll container to its available containing block.
rules.limits: This may be a defensive constraint only. A correctly functioning original wrapper may already confine the table. The table can remain wider than the viewport inside the scroll region.

rules.before: A complete table with the literal tableShape above, min-width at least 640px or 40em/rem, and no existing open HTML ancestor at its source position.
rules.after: The exact table source is enclosed by one div with max-width:100%;min-width:0;overflow-x:auto.
rules.purpose: Keep a deliberately wide table reachable through local horizontal scrolling without widening the article page.
rules.limits: The thresholds select candidate shapes only and are never written as replacement table widths. Unknown wrappers and ancestors remain unchanged.

retention: Every byte between each table opening and closing marker remains identical.
Column count, cell order, row and column spans, header scopes, captions, links, reference calls, numeric sorting attributes, table styles and table minimum widths remain identical.
The source text and the full edit list bind the proof. Stale or substituted plans decline.
A second pure plan and a second complete production adjustment produce no additional responsive change.
notAutomated: Removing an intentional table minimum width.
Combining or deleting columns or cells.
Forcing all tables into a universal width or reducing text size.
Replacing unknown layout wrappers, floats, clipping, custom classes or computed styles.

localLayoutMatrix.method: An independent local HTML projection of the regression table's attributes, labels and first visible row. This geometry test is not a complete native Wikipedia skin reproduction or an actual browser zoom test.
